definitions.gloss: to ripen; to become ripe (of fruit or grain)
definitions.explanation: For fruit, grain, or seeds to reach full maturity, becoming sweet, soft, and ready to eat. Intransitive: the fruit is the subject, and there is no object.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{桃|もも}→桃：04382_momo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{熟|う}れて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This peach is not ripe yet.

examples.japanese: {熟|う}れた⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|いた}み→傷む：10061_itamu⟧やすい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: Ripe fruit is sweet but spoils easily, so it is better to eat it soon.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. The fruit ripens by itself: ⟦{桃|もも}→桃：04382_momo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熟|う}れる. To say that someone ripens fruit, use ⟦{熟|じゅく}させる→熟す：18384_jukusu⟧ or ⟦{追熟|ついじゅく}→追熟：30513_tsuijuku⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧.

ASPECT (ている):
{熟|う}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ normally describes the resulting state ('is ripe'), not an action in progress, so it is the form learners meet most often. {熟|う}れる on its own points to the future or to a general truth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{熟|う}れた: nicely ripened
- {熟|う}れた⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧: ripe fruit
- {熟|う}れすぎる: to become overripe
- ⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{熟|う}れて⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧: not ripe yet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{熟|じゅく}す→熟す：18384_jukusu⟧: to ripen — same meaning, more formal, and also used figuratively of a time being ripe (⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熟|じゅく}す→熟す：18384_jukusu⟧)
- ⟦{実|みの}る→実る：00282_minoru⟧: to bear fruit — focuses on fruit forming, and is common figuratively for efforts paying off
- ⟦{売|う}れる→売れる：02012_ureru⟧: to sell — an unrelated homophone; the kanji tells them apart
